scope: Conceptual closed UPS, generic distribution cabinets and perimeter room cooling. Code-native geometry inspired by vendor external construction; NOT exact vendor CAD, dimensions, validated airflow, electrical engineering or live telemetry.

sources.title: Galaxy VL official product image

limitations: No visible internal fans, compressors, live electrical components, cable entries or undocumented internals invented.
Grille and fastener geometry is representational; exact counts are not vendor specifications.
Enclosure proportions retain existing scene obstacles, not manufacturer product dimensions.
Displays have no fabricated readings; UPS A/B are scenario labels rather than a guaranteed redundancy design.
No external vendor images bundled or required at runtime.
